posts.text: Q1 FY27 Concall notes: Exceptional hike in Industrial gas segment from 4 mmscmd (Q4 FY26) to 7 mmscmd (Q1 FY27) due to unavailability of propane due to geopolitical issues. This is normalizing now with current run rate of 3 mmscmd, as industrial users have started sourcing Propane now. Propane is competitively priced now , in comparision to Natural Gas and hence the shift. Few industrial users do not have Propane infastructure, so they will consume Natural gas despite Propane being cheap.
